programme.title: Due East
programme.desc: A smart, hardworking high school senior has been an outsider for almost 4 years. When a fellow loner moves to Due East, she finds herself in a relationship for the first time, leading to a small town scandal that changes her life forever.

programme.title: Breaking Through
programme.desc: Patsy McCartle is a widow with two sons trying to gather all the money she has to pay for her car, bills, and her son's medication, all of which she can barely afford. Patsy then turns to dealing drugs and becomes addicted to crystal meth. Her only way of recovery rests in the hands of her children.

programme.title: For One Night
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of an African American teenager who shook up a small town where high school proms had been racially segregated for decades. Amid the protests of the community and with the help of a newspaper reporter who returns to her hometown to cover the story, the two women are able to reverse decades of racist tradition and make history, at least for one night. The movie is based on events that occurred in Taylor County, Georgia in 2002.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: The Curse Of the King Tut
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of archaeologist Danny Fremont who in 1922 Cairo, searches for the emerald tablet of Egyptian pharaoh King Tut, the boy king, believing that it holds the power to control the world. His nemesis Morgan Sinclair, archaeologist and sinister member of a secret society Hellfire Council, also wants to find the tablet and use it for evil purposes. Fremont will be joined on his quest to find Tutankhamun's tomb and the tablet by a team of adventures, including egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat.

programme.title: The Curse Of the King Tut
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, the great Child King Tutankhamen ruled. Few know the details of his life no one knows the secrets of his death. But all is about to change. In 1922 Cairo, free-spirited archaeologist Danny Fremont is certain that if found, King Tut's Emerald Tablet would hold the ultimate power to control the world. But unfortunately, the only person who believes Fremont is his ruthless archaeologist nemesis Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it and then extend their world domination. But with the help of a crackerjack team adventurers that includes the doubting egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat, Fremont ventures through the Valley of the Kings, toward Tut's tomb, near the portal to the underworld, and getting closer to the truth behind a mystery that will change the world forever or end it.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: It's tornadoes, hurricanes, electrical storms, and mass destruction as the effects of global warming brew into a super storm that threatens to rend the earth with an unprecedented power. Beautiful scientist Faith Clavell, storm chaser Tommy Tornado, and Judith Carr, the head of FEMA, can stop the inevitable from happening-if they have the courage to venture into the roiling blackness of the storm itself.

programme.title: Charms for the Easy Life
programme.desc: Drama with Gena Rowlands. The story of three women who live in a North Carolina town and defy the traditional roles set forth for them by society.

programme.title: A Bear Named Winnie
programme.desc: Based on the true story behind author A.A. Milne's beloved character, Winnie the Pooh, this is a tale of the remarkable friendship between a Canadian soldier and the cub that stood as a symbol of friendship and hope in a world plagued by war.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: The opening episode sees our experts examine how Henry VIII's traumatic childhood affected his personality – from the death of his older brother, which made him heir to the throne of England, to the tragic early death of his beloved mother. The effect of her death on Henry is dramatically revealed in a recent discovery of an extraordinary, illustrated manuscript portraying the young prince weeping inconsolably over her loss. Henry's complex relationship with his controlling father – Henry VII – is explored as he kept the teenage Henry as a virtual prisoner, passing on his own paranoia that would mark his son's personality for the rest of his life. As soon as his father dies and Henry becomes King Henry VIII, he brutally executes his father's closest advisors and issues a public proclamation criticising the old King's reign. Alongside death and fraught family relationships, this episode charts the extraordinary rise of Cardinal Wolsey – the son of a commoner who rises ruthlessly through the court to become Henry's chief advisor and closest friend. With exclusive access to the archives of the Vatican Library, Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman analyses an account from a foreign ambassador, which has never appeared on camera before – it reveals Wolsey's expertise in manipulating Henry and includes incredible detail about their complex personal relationship. Their friendship unravels however, when Wolsey fails to get Henry's divorce agreed so he can marry Anne Boleyn and Wolsey falls from Henry's grace as quickly as he rose. Strange quirks begin to appear in Henry's personality. He becomes obsessed with the problem that would dominate his reign – his lack of a male heir – and he becomes increasingly controlling, developing an unnerving habit of avoiding direct eye contact with others. In his rise to power, Henry has transformed from an anxious prince into a powerful monarch completely convinced of his own supremacy – but in the process, he will plunge the country into chaos.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers on a journey of marriage, affairs and tyrannical politics. It explores how Henry's obsession with marrying Anne Boleyn results in a cataclysmic and hugely unpopular split with the Roman Catholic Church, while his relationship with Anne turns from infatuation to deadly hatred. Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman reveals the true nature of Henry's early infatuation when she visits the archives of the Vatican Library in Rome to catch a privileged glimpse of Henry's love letters to Anne. Henry also has a secret weapon, his new chief advisor and enforcer – Thomas Cromwell – who personally oversees the plunder and destruction of Catholic monasteries across the land. But, Henry's behaviour is becoming increasingly paranoid and tyrannical. Historian Dr Robert Hutchinson visits the Parliamentary Archives to see the legal document – The Treason Act – that turned Tudor England into a virtual dictatorship under Henry. He also examines a striking contemporary diary entry, which reveals that a jousting injury probably caused Henry to have a traumatic brain injury, making him irritable and suspicious of everyone around him. After the accident, Henry's court becomes a nest of vipers where no one is safe, particularly Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell, who bear the brunt of the King's increasingly unhinged behaviour. Desperate to save his own neck, Thomas Cromwell plots against Anne, finding 'evidence' that she had an affair behind Henry's back with not one but five men. Anne is found guilty of treason and executed. Thomas Cromwell has out manoeuvred her, and Henry has got what he wanted – the chance for a new wife and a male heir.

programme.title: 10.5: Apocalypse
programme.desc: When a tsunami wipes Waikiki off the map, Dr. Hill's fears about the quake's after-effects are justified. Areas seismically quiet for centuries are awakened: Bald Mountain is engulfed in a deadly cloud of smoke and ash, boiling water rises from the earth, the Hoover Dam crumbles and Mount Rushmore explodes in a fiery burst of molten lava.

programme.title: 10.5: Apocalypse
programme.desc: Las Vegas hotels have sunken into the ground, Dr. Hill and the remaining survivors are racing to escape, Meanwhile, the massive earthquake is threatening to split North America in half and the Nuclear Power plant is right in the path.

programme.title: Good Fences
programme.desc: Good Fences is about an upwardly-mobile Black family for whom the American dream becomes a nightmare. In the 1970s, Tom Spader is an attorney who is determined to end what he has dubbed "the colored man's losing streak." When his winning of a high-profile case thrusts him into the limelight, he decides to move his wife and their two kids out of their mixed lower-middle-class town and into the posh enclave of Greenwich, Connecticut.

programme.title: Blackbeard
programme.desc: Action-packed historical drama starring Angus Macfadyen as the fearsome English pirate of the early 18th century known as Blackbeard. Lieutenant Robert Maynard is sent from Great Britain to the seas surrounding the West Indies. His mission is to destroy an infamous pirate ship, known as The Queen Anne's Revenge, and to put an end to its villainous crew including the ill-famed Blackbeard. Also starring Mark Umbers and Jessica Chastain.

programme.title: Casanova
programme.desc: He was the world's most notorious seducer. A swashbuckler, master of disguise and wit - it was said no woman could resist Casanova's amorous charms. Until now. For the first time in his life, the legendary Casanova (Heath Ledger) is about to meet his match with an alluring Ventian beauty, Francesca (Sienna Miller), who does the one thing he never thought possible: refuse him. Through a series of clever disguises and scheming ruses, he manages to get ever closer to Francesca. But he is playing the most dangerous game he has ever encountered - one that will risk not only his life and reputation, but his only chance at true passion.

programme.title: The Outsider
programme.desc: An investigation of a dead daughter begins when a military contractor Lex Walker (Craig Fairbrass) arrives in Los Angeles and he finds the body is not his daughter's. Lex Walker, a British mercenary battling in Afghanistan who drops everything to hurry to Los Angeles when he is informed that his daughter Samantha, who he has not seen in many years, has been found dead. When he arrives at the morgue to identify the body, he is for some reason unsurprised to discover that it is not hers. So he begins a one-man investigation into her whereabouts, trailed by the suspicious detective (Jason Patric) assigned to the case. He soon makes his way to Samantha's boss, Karl Schuster (James Caan), the millionaire CEO of a high-tech company who offers sympathy but little help. It quickly becomes obvious that Schuster is hiding something, since he displays no hesitation about shooting one of his henchmen to death in his own office. Aided by a sexy barmaid (Shannon Elizabeth) enticed by his offer of a $10,000 finder's fee, the take-no-prisoners Lex sets out getting to the bottom of the mystery, beating up or shooting the myriad human obstacles who get in his way. It all leads to his discovery of a massive identity-theft scheme engineered by Schuster about which Lex's very much alive daughter (Melissa Ordway) has the goods.

programme.title: Annie's Point
programme.desc: Richard Eason is flat-out filling his late father's shoes as CEO of an east Coast real estate developing company, so he can't spend nearly as much time with mother Annie and daughter Ella as they would like. Annie is dead-set on visiting a place in California where she and her late husband hoped to build their dream house and convinces Ella, who wants to drop out of school and aspires a singing career, to drive along. Ill-prepared but tempestuously stubborn, they embark on an adventurous road trip, where Ella meets hunky waiter Scott Tardy. Learning Annie needs surgery soon, Richard gives chase.

programme.title: Last Call
programme.desc: Drugged-out Shaun Ryder (Walliams) and classically-trained dancer and musical star Bez (Lucas) discuss their roots, daily living routine and a rather nice package holiday they went on. (24 December 2000).

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: Elizabeth remains a threat in her childless Catholic sister's eyes. Queen Mary is still on the throne and with her harsh politics, she excessively pursues the persecution of Protestants, even of her sister. Queen Mary knows that her sister has a large number of supporters in England, and therefore, she imprisons Elizabeth in the tower and later puts her under house arrest. When Queen Mary surprisingly dies from a tumor, Elizabeth becomes Queen of England. William Cecil, her advisor, warns Elizabeth of the dangers that the married Robert Dudley may, due to their inappropriate relation, cause as a member of the Privy Council.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: The pressure on Elizabeth grows as there is still no marriage and consequently no heir to the throne. Elizabeth fears that her cousin Mary Queen of Scots, recently widowed, might claim her right to the throne of England. However she is resolute in thinking that she can rule alone. Meanwhile she continues to meet Robert Dudley. When his wife dies, rumors spread that Elizabeth might be behind her death. Details of a plot to replace Elizabeth with Mary are uncovered by Walsingham. Even the Duke of Norfolk seems to be involved and is subsequently sent to the tower.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
programme.desc: Old enemies, Maggie and Negan, travel to a crumbling, post-apocalyptic Manhattan to fulfill a dangerous mission; filled with the dead and living dwellers, New York City has been transformed into a world full of chaos, danger, terror and beauty.

programme.title: Two Fathers: Justice for the Innocent
programme.desc: Two fathers from very different backgrounds reunite after eight years to pursue the escaped drug dealer responsible for the deaths of their son and daughter.

programme.title: The Hollywood Mom's Mystery
programme.desc: Lucy Freers has a long-standing marriage, a nine-year old daughter, and a great family life in the suburbs of Hollywood. Great, that is, until the Hollywood set decides that motherhood is the newest way to go. When local neighbor Julia Prentice, the wife of a famous movie actor, adopts a baby in full view of the show-business media, the parenthood craze hits its peak. Soon after, Julia is found lying dead in Lucy's swimming pool, with Lucy and her husband labeled as suspects. Now Lucy must determine the truth to clear the name of both herself and her family.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Barcelona" - "Olympiacos"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Wild Florida
programme.desc: The coral islands, lush mangroves and sandy beaches of the Florida coastline may seem idyllic. But for its wild inhabitants coping with continued development and human encroachment, plus a host of natural predators, the edge of the sea is a paradise filled with peril. Bordered between seashore and suburbia, legions of Loggerhead turtle hatchlings begin their epic journey from sandy shores to the depths of the open ocean. If they are to return to their natal beaches as adults, they must survive a gauntlet of predators including sharks and invasive lionfish stalking the reefs. The American crocodile patrols the brackish waters, always looking for an ambush to satisfy his appetite. But in this difficult hunting season, the croc will struggle to find food. Life on Florida's deadly coast is no day at the beach.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa is a land sculpted by time where animals have evolved complex weapons to arm them in the battle to live another day. An elephant's tusks can defend, or attack. An octopus uses camouflage to find food, or hide from an enemy. A Cape Fur Seal's speed and agility are valuable tools to catch a penguin, but ineffectual against a Great White Shark. A single hippopotamus holds a pride of twelve lions at bay with his sheer bulk, but backs down when faced with the piercing teeth of another hippo. With lethal weapons wielded by fearsome predators and prey, animals walk a precarious path, here among Africa's Deadliest.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Long after the age of dinosaurs, giants still roam this planet. Engineered to withstand the test of time, these animals have supersized bodies, thick skin, sharp teeth and bad attitudes. This is the world of Africa's giant killers. Hippos, elephants, buffalo and others battle it out to become Africa's deadliest. If they're not being targeted by gangs of lions, hyenas or other predators, then they're fighting among themselves. Sometimes offense is their best defense, and there's nothing more terrifying than watching an enormous peace-loving animal turn on the temper. There will be blood.

Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. Along with their two sons, Charlie and Chase, the Schroeder family is always on the go as their veterinary practice cares for the region's many animals in need. From winter blizzards to spring tornadoes and blistering summer heat waves, Drs. Ben and Erin overcome the obstacles with skill and heart.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: You want to up the odds of success, up the numbers. The more attackers there are the better their chances and the bigger the prey. A single lion cant take on a giraffe, but a pride will pull it down. A wild dog has no chance against a wildebeest, but a pack will rip it apart. Watch out for any hungry gang when they have their eyes set on a target. These are the animals that thirst for blood in a group. These are Africas gang killers.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Long after the age of dinosaurs, giants still roam this planet. Engineered to withstand the test of time, these animals have supersized bodies, thick skin, sharp teeth and bad attitudes. This is the world of Africa's giant killers. Hippos, elephants, buffalo and others battle it out to become Africa's deadliest. If they're not being targeted by gangs of lions, hyenas or other predators, then they're fighting among themselves. Sometimes offense is their best defense, and there's nothing more terrifying than watching an enormous peace-loving animal turn on the temper. There will be blood.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa is a land sculpted by time where animals have evolved complex weapons to arm them in the battle to live another day. An elephant's tusks can defend, or attack. An octopus uses camouflage to find food, or hide from an enemy. A Cape Fur Seal's speed and agility are valuable tools to catch a penguin, but ineffectual against a Great White Shark. A single hippopotamus holds a pride of twelve lions at bay with his sheer bulk, but backs down when faced with the piercing teeth of another hippo. With lethal weapons wielded by fearsome predators and prey, animals walk a precarious path, here among Africa's Deadliest.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa's Deadliest Ambush Hunters is an awe-inspiring ride through a world of camouflage, patience, and precision. We follow these stealthy predators as they make use of their environments and special skill sets to avoid detection until the very last second. Lying in wait across the continent, from the lush Serengeti to the desert of Namibia, ambush predators are poised for action. Follow the lethal stone-fish as he waits for his prey, and the most venomous cobra in Africa as he sneaks into a weaver's nest. Prepare to be inspired by the leopard's quick-footedness and determination, and the crocodile's patient approach. A thrilling ride packed with sudden strikes from Africa's Deadliest Ambush Hunters.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Skonis, vedantis namo
programme.desc: Antoni Porowski pakviečia šešis žinomus žmones drauge keliauti į atradimų ir netikėtumų kupinas keliones. Kulinarinė atradimų kelionė padeda Italijoje, Vokietijoje ir Didžiojoje Britanijoje gyvenančioms žvaigždėms atrasti savo kultūrines šaknis tolimuose jų protėvių kraštuose: Senegale, Pietų Korėjoje ir Borneo. Ar maistas gali papasakoti šeimos istoriją ir atkurti ryšį su seniai prarastais giminaičiais? Kokius potyrius gali atskleisti tam tikrą maistą pajutę skonio receptoriai?

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Best friends and cadets-in-training Swift, Penny, Rod, and Brody congregate at Top Wing Academy, where they learn what it takes to gain their wings and become rescue birds on Big Swirl Island. Swift is a blue jay and the fastest pilot at the academy; Penny, the only female in the group, is a penguin, and she is an expert at undersea life; Brody is a puffin who takes a more land approach, and Rod is a rooster who is ready to fly around Big Swirl Island in his all-terrain vehicle. The four friends are joined by their mentor Speedy, who helps the cadets on their different missions. "Top Wing" focuses on the importance of teamwork and the ability to successfully solve problems.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: "Black School Rules" Sora is a high school student who is basically invisible at school. He is friends with Chuya who is an upredictable character that often surprises those around him. Sora and Chuya both have feelings for the same classmate, Kio Machida. Machida girl refuses to come to class, because she doesn't want to dye her naturally brown hair black. Their school has unreasonable school rules, especially about uniforms which including requiring all students to have black hair. Sora and Chuya decide to stand up to change their school's black school rules so that Machida won't have to repeat a year of school from missing too many classes.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: Breadwinners

They find new friends, deal with opponents and have fun, making sure Pondgea always receive fresh bread on time.

SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
programme.desc: Paper and Pencil tell a kind of funny joke at a party and chase the feeling of people finding them funny by telling it again and again; Scissors hires an orchestra to follow him around and score his life.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Wylde Pak
programme.desc: On their way back from Lake World, the Wylde Paks get stuck in a massive traffic jam. The situation gets so dire that all the drivers have no choice but to set up camp - a camp that quickly turns into its own, self-governing, rudimentary society. Struggling with a vacuum of power, Jack is chosen as their reluctant leader, but he's determined to usher them into peace. Meanwhile, Lily catches feelings for a boy in a nearby car, but because the boy's dad and Will have serious road rage beef, their romance is forbidden. // Desperate to leave their mark on Canyon Valley, Jack and Lily set out to capture the great beast of Canyon Valley Lake - a giant fish that has menaced the town for years. After being swallowed whole multiple times, Lily and Jack realize they must take a different approach, but then they hear horror stories from other townsfolk about their own run-ins with the giant fish proving that bagging the beast is an impossible task. Despite all this, Lily and Jack attempt to accomplish the impossible.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.desc: Corrado Guzzanti, Lucia Mascino e Kasia Smutniak in una graffiante commedia sull'Italia di oggi, scritta e diretta da Rolando Ravello. Durante la ricreazione nel cortile di una scuola elementare, nel periodo di Natale, un bambino musulmano rompe una finestra con una pietra e ferisce lievemente un bidello. Il piccolo incidente innesca una serie di colpi di scena e reazioni inaspettate in un dibattito che coinvolgerà docenti, alunni e parenti. Tratto dall’opera teatrale di Stefano Massini. Rolando Ravello è stato fra gli sceneggiatori del fortunatissimo "Perfetti sconosciuti".

programme.desc: Una squadra di comici, capitanati da Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano, per una commedia sull'Italia di oggi. I Tucci sono una numerosa famiglia di un paesino laziale. Da sempre poveri, vincono 100 milioni alla lotteria e la loro vita si trasforma. Per non far sapere di essere i fortunati possessori del biglietto, si trasferiscono in un lussuoso hotel milanese dando vita a un'escalation di risate e a una serie di situazioni paradossali. programme.desc: Celebre commedia diretta da Carlo Vanzina con Jerry Calà e Christian De Sica. Estate 1964: sulle spiagge della Versilia si intrecciano le vicende di un gruppo di vacanzieri in cerca di avventure, in particolare quelle di Paolo e Marina, due fratelli napoletani, e di Luca e Felicino, fratelli milanesi ricchi e viziati. Amori e avventure in un periodo per molti indimenticabile. Sullo sfondo i successi musicali dei meravigliosi anni 60. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior attrice non protagonista a Virna Lisi.

programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 3 Golden Globe al dramma musicale con Hugh Jackman, Anne Hathaway e Russell Crowe, dal romanzo di Victor Hugo. Un ex detenuto si riscostruisce una nuova vita sotto falso nome.

programme.title: Sai che c'è di nuovo?
programme.desc: Madonna e Rupert Everett in una commedia di John Schlesinger. Una maestra di yoga e un giardiniere gay, amici per la pelle, fanno sesso dopo una notte di euforia e lei rimane incinta...

programme.desc: Un cast di star hollywoodiane per una commedia sul mistero dell'amore. A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. Dal regista di "Pretty Woman", il film negli Stati Uniti e' uscito nel giorno di San Valentino, incassando al debutto 57 milioni di dollari.

programme.desc: Secondo film dedicato all'omonima serie. La famiglia Crawley si trasferisce in Costa Azzurra, mentre Lady Mary rimane nella tenuta di Downton Abbey, scelta come location per un film.

programme.desc: Romantica commedia con Blanche Gardin e Laurent Lafitte. In viaggio verso Lisbona per vendere la casa della madre defunta, una donna depressa ritrova un amico stravagante.

programme.desc: Giovanni Veronesi dirige una commedia con Sergio Castellitto, Pilar Fogliati e Margherita Buy. Per ottenere la parte e dimostrare il suo talento, una giovane attrice si traveste da uomo.

programme.desc: Richard Gere e Winona Ryder in una struggente love story. Sullo sfondo della Grande Mela, un uomo maturo si innamora di una ragazza affetta da una malattia incurabile.

programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann (il regista di "Mouline Rouge!") dirige Leonardo DiCaprio, Carey Mulligan e Tobey Maguire nello sfarzoso adattamento, vincitore di due Oscar, del celebre romanzo di Francis S. Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. America, anni '20: un aspirante scrittore, Nick Carraway, entra nel mondo di Jay Gatsby, un misterioso milionario ossessionato dall'amore impossibile per Daisy: la donna da lui amata e che vorrebbe riconquistare. Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.

programme.title: Primadonna
programme.desc: La battaglia di una donna nel primo lungometraggio di Marta Savina. Sicilia, anni 60: Lia rifiuta un matrimonio riparatore trascinando Lorenzo e i suoi complici in tribunale.

programme.desc: Annette Bening e Bill Nighy in un film sulla separazione. Edward annuncia alla moglie Grace di voler divorziare dopo 30 anni di matrimonio. Una decisione che spiazza tutta la famiglia.

programme.desc: 2 Golden Globe al film di Alexander Payne con Jack Nicholson e Kathy Bates. Un vedovo attraversa l'America in un viaggio alla scoperta delle sue emozioni più profonde.

programme.desc: Dalla penna di Stephen King, un emozionante inno alla vita diretto da Mike Flanagan. La straordinaria vita dell'uomo comune Charles Krantz (Tom Hiddleston) raccontata a ritroso.

programme.desc: Sci-fi movie con Jean Reno e Hugo Becker, opera prima di Romain Quirot. 2050: un planetoide ha desertificato il globo e ora sta per distruggerlo. Paul e' l'unico astronauta che puo' fermarlo.

programme.title: Marcel!
programme.desc: Opera prima di Jasmine Trinca, con Alba Rohrwacher e Valeria Golino. La figlia di un'artista di strada vuole conquistare l'amore della madre, che sembra essere piu' legata al suo cane.

programme.desc: Edoardo Pesce nel noir urbano di Fulvio Risuleo. Roma: un poliziotto sorprende il giovane Tarek a comprare dell'erba e lo costringe a una notte in giro per Roma a bordo della sua macchina.

programme.title: What They Had
programme.desc: Hilary Swank e Michael Shannon in un dramma familiare. Tornata nella casa di Chicago per gestire la malattia della madre, Bridget è costretta a fare i conti con rancori mai sopiti.

programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo venturo un investigatore ha il compito di eliminare un gruppo di androidi assassini in fuga dal loro artefice, ma nel corso della propria ricerca viene a conoscenza di una verità terrificante.

programme.title: Al di la' dei sogni
programme.desc: Toccante film soprannaturale con Robin Williams. Un uomo viaggia dal Paradiso all'Inferno per salvare la moglie suicida, condannata alla dannazione eterna. Oscar agli effetti speciali.

programme.desc: Dakota Johnson e Sean Penn instaurano una connessione profonda in un film di rivelazioni e complicità, opera prima di Christy Hall. La conversazione fra una donna e un tassista nel tragitto dall'aeroporto JFK e Manhattan diventa un lungo dialogo sulle loro emozioni più intime.

programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Cate Blanchett in una pellicola di Woody Allen. Una donna in crisi lascia New York e si trasferisce a San Francisco per rimettere ordine nella sua vita.

programme.desc: Oliver Stone dirige Al Pacino e un cast di divi per descrivere il mondo del football americano attraverso la storia di un allenatore in crisi, alla guida di una squadra che non sa piu' vincere. Tony D'Amato e i suoi Miami Sharks perdono una partita dietro l'altra, il quarterback titolare e' fuori per infortunio e la giovane e affascinante proprietaria della squadra e' decisa a far fuori il coach. Ma mandarlo via non e' per nulla facile, la squadra e' con Tony e tra un problema e l'altro riesce a qualificarsi per i playoff. Dentro o fuori, non ci sono alternative.

programme.title: Scomode verità
programme.desc: Mike Leigh dirige un potente dramma con Marianne Jean-Baptiste e Michele Austin. Pansy, una donna astiosa e irascibile, sempre in conflitto con il mondo, trova finalmente la forza di confessare il segreto che ferisce il suo animo durante una riunione di famiglia.

programme.title: Nour
programme.desc: Sergio Castellitto nella pellicola di Maurizio Zaccaro sulla complessa realtà degli sbarchi dei migranti. Un dottore di stanza a Lampedusa prende a cuore il caso di una bambina siriana.

programme.desc: Esordio alla regia del giovane Simone Bozzelli. Yuri ha vent'anni quando incontra Agostino, un animatore girovago con cui inizia un viaggio alla ricerca del senso della liberta'.

La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.desc: Fabrizio Moro debutta alla regia con Alessio De Leonardis in un film con Giacomo Ferrara e Vinicio Marchioni. Roma: un ragazzo di borgata cerca nella boxe il riscatto da una vita difficile.

programme.title: Come ammazzare il capo 2
programme.desc: Sequel di "Come ammazzare il capo... e vivere felici" con un cast di star hollywoodiane. Nick, Dale e Kurt decidono di mettersi in proprio, ma dovranno vedersela con un cinico investitore.

programme.title: Come ti spaccio la famiglia
programme.desc: Jennifer Aniston e Jason Sudeikis in una demenziale commedia 'on the road'. Un piccolo spacciatore di marijuana si trova nei guai con il proprio fornitore, dopo che un gruppo di punk gli ha rubato merce e denaro. Costretto a cambiare genere, finisce coinvolto in un pericoloso traffico di droghe ben più pesanti, che dovrà consegnare in Messico. Per riuscire a passare il confine inosservato decide di farsi passare per un perfetto padre di famiglia, in viaggio per il weekend del 4 luglio, coinvolgendo i suoi vicini di casa nel pazzo piano.

programme.title: Speciale: Nord Sud Ovest Est
programme.desc: Un racconto corale dietro le quinte della serie. Attori, registi e capi reparto svelano il set, le scelte creative e il successo del progetto.

programme.title: Now you see me - I maghi del crimine
programme.desc: Illusionismo e colpi di scena in un thriller con Jesse Eisenberg, Mark Ruffalo e Morgan Freeman. Quattro maghi inscenano spettacolari trucchi di magia, sempre connessi a giganteschi furti.

programme.title: Now You See Me 2 - I maghi del crimine
programme.desc: Torna la banda di illusionisti in un thriller con Jesse Eisenberg, Mark Ruffalo, Michael Caine e Morgan Freeman. I Quattro Cavalieri elaborano un piano per smascherare un corrotto magnate.

programme.title: L'illusione perfetta - Now You See Me: Now You Don't
programme.desc: I 'Quattro cavalieri' e una nuova generazione di illusionisti uniscono le forze per rubare il diamante più grande del mondo a un magnate sudafricano a capo di un'organizzazione criminale internazionale.

programme.title: The Estate

programme.title: Bye Bye Morons - Addio a tutti
programme.desc: Virginie Efira in una commedia amara vincitrice di 6 Cesar. Dopo aver scoperto di essere malata, una donna decide di cercare il figlio che aveva abbandonato da adolescente dopo il parto.

programme.title: Le amiche della sposa
programme.desc: Commedia di successo di Paul Feig con Kristen Wiig e Melissa McCarthy. Annie, damigella d'onore alle nozze della migliore amica Lilian, deve arginare le mosse astute delle altre ragazze.

programme.title: Come ammazzare il capo 2

programme.title: Un Natale con i Fiocchi
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann e Silvio Orlando in una commedia firmata Sky Cinema. Un poliziotto incontra dopo anni un vecchio amico che sbarca il lunario facendo l'autista per rapinatori.

programme.desc: La commedia di Wes Anderson con Benicio Del Toro segue le vicissitudini di un magnate megalomane e di sua figlia, una giovane novizia. In un vortice di colpi di scena e personaggi caricaturali, i due cercano di portare a termine un folle progetto.

programme.desc: Commedia noir di Herbert Simone Paragnani con Ilenia Pastorelli e Pietro Sermonti. Un uomo riceve la visita dell’Angelo della Morte, una donna seducente che gli mostra le impurità della sua vita. Il loro accordo si rivelerà pericoloso per entrambi.
